重生不为后之嫡女无双最新章节_第一章 堕胎 一第1页_重生不为后之嫡女无双痞子雪_热点小说网
> 第一章 堕胎 一（第1页）
黄昏的雪，深切切的，好象有千丝万缕的情绪似的，又像海水一般汹涌，能够淹没一切，还有一丝揭开藏头露尾般的裸露感。
雪花形态万千、晶莹透亮，好象出征的战士，披着银色的盔甲，又像是一片片白色的战帆在远航……
一直以来，蓝若晴都觉得下雪的冬夜是最美的。
在红色纱灯下，白色的雪成淡淡的粉色，使得周围的环境都变得温暖起来。
四周静谧的空气，使得人心平气和。
无论怎样不平的情绪，在这样的天气里，都会变得平静。
大雪从凌晨开始下，天地间浑然成一色！大概是在和全国的民众一起哀悼辞世的明君——晟睿国的皇帝皇甫伟祺。
皇甫伟祺年轻时征战四方，历尽艰辛，建立晟睿国。
自新国成立后，减赋税，救灾民，惩贪官，为国为民，呕心沥血，整日操劳，终因太过疲劳，于今日凌晨驾崩。
如今，整个京城乃至整个国家都悬挂着白色的灯笼，京城里笼罩着哀伤的气氛。
这个雪夜，蓝若晴的心情同样无法平静。
不止是为了全城悼念信晨被她的丈夫下毒致死而离世的皇上，还有面对她即将失去的爱情。
围坐在火炉旁，蓝若晴看着对面这个她爱了五年，同床共枕三年的男人皇甫陌轩。
没有想到，皇甫陌轩居然听信别人的说辞，亲手端来这碗堕胎药要她服下。
红红的炉火没有给蓝若晴带来丝毫的暖意，反而是那碗药，让她觉得浑身冰冷，似三九天仅着了一件单衣般寒冷。
蓝若晴，晟睿国将军蓝烨磊与夫人沈沛珊唯一的女儿，京城四大才女之一。
当年的蓝若晴因容貌出众，艳压群芳。更因琴棋书画样样精通，诗词歌赋无人能比，被皇上封为京城四大美人之首。
五年前在王宫宫廷宴会期间意外落水，被云王皇甫陌轩救下。

那一刻，蓝若晴对皇甫陌轩一见倾心，认定了他，从此跟随在他左右。一心辅佐，出谋划策，排除异己，直至前太子皇甫皓轩早逝，再助他得到太子之位。
如今，皇甫陌轩即将登上帝位，却要新手扼杀蓝若晴肚子里的小生命，甚至不惜有失去她的可能。
“蓝若晴，你喝下这碗药，我还会待你如从前，这皇后之位，仍然会由你来做。”太子皇甫陌轩面无表情的说着。
听到这虚伪的誓言，蓝若晴抬头看着这个曾经让她心动不已，俊帅无比的男人。
此刻在他的眼中看不到一点点爱恋与怜惜。
厌恶的眼神，已充分的说出了他的心事。
或许在他的心中，早已判定她的死刑了吧？
五年前的那次落水，蓝若晴落下了宫寒的毛病。
虽然后来看了很多的医生，也用了很多的方子，可是疗效都不大。
嫁给云王三年多一直不能成孕。蓝若晴是多么希望在帮助皇甫陌轩争取到帝位的同时，也可以为他生个属于自己的孩子。
当蓝若晴被大夫告知说是有喜了的时候，曾经在心中无数次的幻想着，皇甫陌轩知道她怀有身孕的时候会是怎样的兴奋与激动！
可是，事实如此残酷，皇甫陌轩居然说蓝若晴腹中怀的是野种不能留。
现在，皇甫陌轩在即将登基，成为晟睿国皇帝的前一日，他要拿掉所谓的野种，这个属于他们俩个人的孩子。
蓝若晴的身体里的小生命，不过才存活了三个多月。
皇甫陌轩不是不知道，为了能有这个孩子，蓝若晴吃了多少苦，用了多少药，花了多少心思。
想到此，蓝若晴冷冷的回绝：“你休想动我的孩子！我不会让你得逞的！”

The latest chapter of The Reborn Daughter Wushuang_Chapter 1 Abortion 1 Page 1_The Reborn Daughter Wushuang Ruffian Snow_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 1 Abortion 1 (Page 1)
The snow at dusk is deep, as if there are thousands of emotions, and it is as turbulent as the sea, able to submerge everything, and there is a sense of nakedness like uncovering the hidden head.
The snowflakes have various shapes and are crystal clear, like warriors on an expedition, wearing silver armor, and like pieces of white sails sailing on a long voyage...
Lan Ruoqing has always felt that snowy winter nights are the most beautiful.
Under the red gauze lamp, the white snow turns into a light pink, making the surrounding environment warm.
The quiet air around makes people feel calm.
No matter how rough the mood is, it will become calm in such weather.
The heavy snow started falling in the early morning, and the sky and the earth became one color! Probably he was mourning the passing of the wise emperor with the people across the country - Huangfu Weiqi, the emperor of Shengrui Kingdom.
When Huangfu Weiqi was young, he fought in all directions and went through many hardships to establish the Shengrui Kingdom.
Since the founding of the new country, he has reduced taxes, provided relief to victims, punished corrupt officials, and served the country and the people with all his heart and soul. He worked hard all day long. Finally, he passed away early this morning due to excessive fatigue.
Nowadays, white lanterns are hung all over the capital and even the whole country, and the capital is enveloped in a sad atmosphere.
On this snowy night, Lan Ruoqing's mood was also unable to calm down.
Not only for the whole city to mourn the death of the emperor who died of Xinchen poisoning by her husband, but also to face the love she was about to lose.
Sitting around the fire, Lan Ruoqing looked at Huangfu Moxuan, the man opposite her who she had loved for five years and shared her bed with for three years.
Unexpectedly, Huangfu Moxuan actually listened to other people's words and personally brought the bowl of abortion pills to her to take.
The red fire did not bring any warmth to Lan Ruoqing, but the bowl of medicine made her feel as cold as if she had only been wearing a single piece of clothing for three-nine days.
Lan Ruoqing, the only daughter of General Lan Yelei of Shengrui Kingdom and his wife Shen Peishan, is one of the four most talented women in the capital.
At that time, Lan Ruoqing was the most beautiful because of her outstanding appearance. Moreover, because she was proficient in music, chess, calligraphy and painting, and her poetry and songs were unparalleled, she was named the first of the four beauties in the capital by the emperor.
Five years ago, he accidentally fell into the water during a palace banquet and was rescued by Yun Wang Huangfu Moxuan.
At that moment, Lan Ruoqing fell in love with Huangfu Moxuan at first sight, recognized him, and followed him from then on. He devoted himself to assisting, making suggestions, and eliminating dissenters, until the former prince Huangfu Haoxuan died early, and then helped him obtain the position of prince.
Now, Huangfu Moxuan is about to ascend to the throne of God, but he wants a novice to strangle the little life in Lan Ruoqing's belly, even at the risk of losing her.
"Lan Ruoqing, if you drink this bowl of medicine, I will treat you as before, and you will still be the queen." Prince Huangfu Moxuan said expressionlessly.
Hearing this false oath, Lan Ruoqing looked up at this extremely handsome man who had once made her heart flutter.
There was no trace of love or pity in his eyes at this moment.
The disgusted look in his eyes fully expressed his thoughts.
Perhaps in his heart, he had already sentenced her to death?
Lan Ruoqing suffered from Gong Han's problem when she fell into the water five years ago.
Although I saw many doctors and used many prescriptions, the effect was not very effective.
After marrying King Yun for more than three years, she has been unable to conceive. Lan Ruoqing hoped that while helping Huangfu Moxuan win the throne, she could also give him a child of her own.
When Lan Ruoqing was told by the doctor that she was pregnant, she imagined countless times in her heart how excited Huangfu Moxuan would be when he knew she was pregnant!
However, the facts were so cruel that Huangfu Moxuan actually said that what Lan Ruoqing was carrying in her belly was a bastard and could not be kept.
Now, Huangfu Moxuan is about to ascend the throne and become the emperor of Shengrui Kingdom.On that day, he wanted to get rid of the so-called bastard, this child that belonged to both of them.
The little life in Lan Ruoqing's body only survived for more than three months.
It's not like Huangfu Moxuan didn't know how much hardship Lan Ruoqing endured, how much medicine she took, and how much thought she spent in order to have this child.
Thinking of this, Lan Ruoqing coldly refused: "Don't even think about touching my child! I won't let you succeed!"
